nodes.description: Address of the current governance account of WrappedIbbtcEth; controls privileged setters.
Address of the nominated pending governance used in the two-step ownership transfer.
ERC20Upgradeable reference to the underlying ibBTC token that is wrapped.
ICore reference used to read pricePerShare from the ibBTC core contract.
Inherited ERC20 mapping of account to wrapped ibBTC share balance (non-rebased).
Inherited ERC20 nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance.
Inherited ERC20 total wrapped share supply.
Initializer that wires governance, core and ibbtc and sets token name/symbol.
Governance-only setter that stores the pending governance address.
Governance-only setter that repoints the core contract.
Pending-governance-only function that finalizes the governance transfer.
Permissionless deposit: pulls ibBTC shares from caller and mints wrapped shares 1:1.
Permissionless redeem: burns wrapped shares then returns underlying ibBTC to caller.
ERC20 transferFrom override converting the rebased amount into shares before transferring.
ERC20 transfer override converting the rebased amount into shares before transferring.
View reading the live ibBTC price per share from the core contract.
View returning the raw wrapped share balance of an account.
View returning shares * pricePerShare / 1e18, i.e. the rebased balance.
View returning the total wrapped share supply.
View returning total shares scaled by price per share.
View converting a rebased balance into shares via pricePerShare.
View converting shares into a rebased balance via pricePerShare.
Inherited internal ERC20 routine that mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
Inherited internal ERC20 routine that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances.
Inherited internal ERC20 routine that debits _balances and decreases _totalSupply.
Inherited internal ERC20 routine that writes the _allowances mapping.
Inherited context helper that returns msg.sender.
Initializable helper using extcodesize to detect constructor context.
Caller-controlled address used for access control checks, minting and allowance updates.
External call ibbtc.transferFrom(...) performed before any state update inside mint.
External call ibbtc.transfer(...) performed after burning shares inside burn.
Unchecked mul/div by pricePerShare used in balanceOf, totalSupply and balanceToShares.
Arithmetic mutation of _balances inside _transfer (sub/add of share amounts).
_governance argument of initialize, assigned to the governance state variable.
_ibbtc argument of initialize, cast to ERC20Upgradeable and stored.
_core argument of initialize, cast to ICore and stored.
_pendingGovernance argument of setPendingGovernance.
_core argument of setCore, repointing the core reference.
_shares argument of mint, the amount of ibBTC shares pulled and minted.
_shares argument of burn, the amount of wrapped shares destroyed.
sender argument of transferFrom/_transfer whose balance is debited.
recipient argument of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer whose balance is credited.
amount argument in rebased units passed to transfer and transferFrom.
account argument of sharesOf and balanceOf.
balance argument of balanceToShares to be converted into shares.
shares argument of sharesToBalance to be converted into a balance.
Local computed as balanceToShares(amount) inside transfer and transferFrom.
Local in the initializer modifier tracking the outermost initialization call.
Local holding address(this) in _isConstructor.
Local holding extcodesize(self) result in _isConstructor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against governance in onlyGovernance to gate setPendingGovernance.
msg.sender is compared against governance in onlyGovernance to gate setCore.
msg.sender is compared against pendingGovernance in onlyPendingGovernance to gate acceptPendingGovernance.
onlyPendingGovernance modifier on msg.sender decides whether acceptPendingGovernance body executes.
msg.sender is the source of the ibBTC pull and the recipient of the minted wrapped shares.
msg.sender is burned from and receives the redeemed ibBTC in burn.
msg.sender is used as the spender in the allowance update inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the debited sender in the transfer override.
_msgSender returns msg.sender verbatim.
_msgSender is the wrapper that surfaces msg.sender to ERC20 logic.
setPendingGovernance writes the pendingGovernance state variable.
setCore overwrites the core state variable.
acceptPendingGovernance assigns pendingGovernance into governance.
acceptPendingGovernance reads pendingGovernance as the new governance value.
initialize sets the initial governance address.
initialize sets the initial core contract reference.
initialize sets the underlying ibBTC token reference.
mint calls the inherited internal _mint to credit shares.
burn calls the inherited internal _burn to destroy shares.
transferFrom calls _transfer with the converted share amount.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
transferFrom converts the rebased amount via balanceToShares.
transfer calls _transfer with the converted share amount.
transfer converts the rebased amount via balanceToShares.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_mint credits the recipient in _balances.
_burn debits the account in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_transfer rewrites sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf reads sharesOf to obtain the raw share balance.
balanceOf reads pricePerShare to scale the share balance.
totalSupply reads totalShares before scaling.
totalSupply reads pricePerShare to scale total shares.
balanceToShares divides by the pricePerShare value.
sharesToBalance multiplies by the pricePerShare value.
pricePerShare reads from the core contract reference.
sharesOf reads the _balances mapping for the queried account.
totalShares reads _totalSupply.
mint invokes the external ibBTC transferFrom before any accounting state change.
A malicious ibBTC token can call back into mint via transferFrom while balances are stale.
burn performs an external ibBTC transfer to the caller after burning shares.
A malicious ibBTC token can call back into burn during the external transfer.
balanceOf performs unchecked share*pricePerShare/1e18 scaling arithmetic.
balanceToShares performs unchecked balance*1e18/pricePerShare arithmetic.
_transfer applies sub/add arithmetic when updating _balances.
The arithmetic results in _transfer are written back into the _balances mapping.
_governance parameter flows into initialize and then into governance.
_ibbtc parameter flows into initialize and then into ibbtc.
_core parameter flows into initialize and then into core.
_pendingGovernance parameter flows into setPendingGovernance.
_core parameter flows into setCore.
_shares parameter flows into the transferFrom and _mint calls of mint.
_shares parameter flows into the _burn and transfer calls of burn.
sender parameter flows into the _transfer and _approve calls of transferFrom.
sender parameter is the debited account inside _transfer.
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer call of transferFrom.
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer call of transfer.
recipient parameter is the credited account inside _transfer.
amount parameter is converted to shares inside transferFrom.
amount parameter is converted to shares inside transfer.
amount parameter determines the _balances mutation inside _transfer.
account parameter indexes the _balances lookup in sharesOf.
account parameter is forwarded to sharesOf from balanceOf.
balance parameter is the multiplicand in balanceToShares.
shares parameter is the multiplicand in sharesToBalance.
amountInShares local determines the share amount used in transferFrom.
amountInShares local determines the share amount used in transfer.
isTopLevelCall local in the initializer modifier guards the initialize entry point.
self local supplies the address passed to extcodesize in _isConstructor.
cs local receives the extcodesize result compared in _isConstructor.

normalization_plan.reason: The _governance parameter has no independent identity outside initialize, where it is immediately assigned to the governance state variable.
The _ibbtc parameter only exists to seed the ibbtc state variable inside initialize.
The _core parameter only exists to seed the core state variable inside initialize.
The _pendingGovernance parameter is only meaningful as the input written to pendingGovernance by setPendingGovernance.
The _core argument of setCore is used solely to repoint the core state variable.
The _shares argument drives the external transferFrom and the internal _mint call of mint and has no other use.
The _shares argument drives the internal _burn and the external transfer call of burn only.
The sender parameter is the debited account of the _transfer balance mutation and is normalized into that routine.
The recipient parameter is the credited account of the _transfer balance mutation and is normalized into that routine.
The amount parameter determines the magnitude of the _balances arithmetic inside _transfer.
The account parameter is only used to index the _balances mapping for a read and is absorbed by balanceOf.
The balance parameter is only a multiplicand in the balanceToShares conversion.
The shares parameter is only a multiplicand in the sharesToBalance conversion.
The amountInShares temporary exists only to carry the converted share amount into the transfer override's _transfer call.
The isTopLevelCall temporary only exists inside the initializer modifier protecting the initialize function.
The self local is a short-lived address(this) holder used only by _isConstructor.
The cs local is a short-lived extcodesize result used only by _isConstructor.
